title: Support `reasoning_effort` for OpenAI `o1` model
body:
### Feature Description

> A new `reasoning_effort` API parameter allows you to control how long the model thinks before answering.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue requests support for a new API parameter (`reasoning_effort`) for an LLM provider (OpenAI `o1` model), which directly concerns LLM provider integration and parameter compatibility—an agent issue per the taxonomy.
